commits.message: Markdown's h2 padding test pins where a wrapped row's style stops, against Rich 15 (rich-unfiled-791c.y0tl)

Markdown pads an h2 and below to the width, as Rich's Heading does (rich-unfiled-791c.y0tl)

Rich 15's Heading.LEVEL_ALIGN gives every level a justify: h1 center, the
rest left, so each row is padded to the width in the base style, not the
heading's. The heading case passed undefined for every level but 1, so
those rows ended at their text. With every level explicit, the
options.justify override beside it was dead and is gone.

TextInput shows a zero-cell glyph as a one-cell stand-in, so every cursor stop moves the drawn cursor (rich-unfiled-791c.k697) (#456)

* TextInput shows a zero-cell glyph as a one-cell stand-in, so every cursor stop moves the drawn cursor (rich-unfiled-791c.k697)

* TextInput's hit-test maps each glyph through one shown-as function instead of re-segmenting it, and a line break's ↵ is pinned (rich-unfiled-791c.k697)
